slug: 2025-09-22 Namibia to build national data centre under 2025-2029 digital strategy

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency says Namibia's National Digital Strategy 2025-2029 was 'unveiled in August 2025'; it names no adopting act or body.
Ecofin Agency gives the National Digital Strategy as 2025-2029, so the period covers the article's date of 22 September 2025; it does not say whether the text is public.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology (MICT)
systems.tiers: described as aiming to leverage technology for economic growth and social inclusion and calling for rapid expansion of digital infrastructure; whether it covers the state's own administration is not stated

note: The strategy's class is left empty because the article's description does not say it covers both the economy and the state.
